description: List invoices and bills from a Xero accounting organisation. Returns compact invoice summaries (number, type, status, contact, dates, total, amount due, currency) for bookkeeping, accounts-receivable, and accounts-payable review. Supports Xero filter expressions and pagination.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Xero returns up to 100 invoices per page.

tenant_id.description: Optional Xero tenant (organisation) id to target. If omitted, the first connected organisation is used. Get ids from list_organisations.

where.description: Optional Xero filter expression (e.g. 'Status=="AUTHORISED"' or 'Type=="ACCREC"'). Applied as the Xero `where` query parameter.

name: list_invoices
title: List Invoices
